notes.title: ue5 upgrade
notes.content:
its been a while since i made any progress on this little project. 
between life and university commitments i haven't had a lot of time. 

but recently i migrated the project from unreal 4.25 to unreal 5. this resulted in a lot of things needing to be rebuilt or replaced. 

i added some new fish to the tank,
removed a few levels down to 16, i felt like there was too many. 
i added a double jump feature
i have tried to get controller support working but it is still pretty janky as i dont actually have a controller to use for testing. 

i plan to work on UI and sounds next.

notes.title: reworking this project
notes.content:
Ok, firstly i would like to thank the small amount of people who got this game. It has not done very well (which is to be expected with no real marketing of this game). but this does not matter, i kind of made it for myself and if anyone else enjoys it that is a bonus.


I made this to teach myself how to use unreal engine and since the release of this game i have learned quite a lot more...

anyways, i had to wipe my hard drive and lost the latest project files for this game. so there will not be any updates for a while. i do have a backup copy of an older build but i have decided to abandon the current project. 

But this isn't to say i have stopped working on this project, in fact i have decided to will completely rebuild the game and hopefully make several improvements! So expect a HUGE update sometime in the distant future. Until then, i will try to put this title on discount as often as i can. After the rebuild update there will be a significant jump in price as with the quality. 

i just wanted to say thanks to those who have played, and to expect a better product sometime in the future. (no timeframe yet, as this will be worked on between university and other commitments)

thank you for your support.

notes.title: New Update (13/4/21)
notes.content:
added a couple of extra controls
(X) will now make the player dash forward a little bit
(Q) will now make the player stop where they are and sink to the floor
hopefully it makes the game a little easier for some...

notes.title: new update
notes.content:
in this update i fixed a couple of bugs that have slipped past me before, and i added a "free swim" level. 

Well, it has been around 6 months since i started trying to learn how to make a game, and this is the result.

i think i am mostly done with this project for now, i intend to fix any bugs that become apparent to users as reported. But for now i think i have achieved all the goals i set out to accomplish with this project. i may return to this project in the future once i have learned more.  

i built the game from a blank template with no knowledge of where to start so i watched a couple of youtube videos to help get started, i used some 3d assets available on epic marketplace and i created the music loops myself.

i hope you find this simple game somewhat enjoyable, and hope that it might inspire others to try and make something better!

thank you for your support!

peace

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you so much for supporting this project!

Today i decided to go ahead of schedule and release my new update a little early. 

I have spent the last couple of weeks tinkering and learning some new things, as a result this game will now have some destructible meshes as well. 

i have added the full 20 levels into this update so now i can focus on tidying it up and improving UI and sound (I intend to make my own music for this game but we will see how that goes).

Since it is just me working on this project and I have not had a great deal of feedback about this game, i am still unsure on which areas need fixing or addressing. I hope to work through it all meticulously from here on anyway. 

I hope you find the new levels enjoyable. 

Thanks for playing
